observed_mismatches: Sparse repeated radial foliage hubs instead of a deep crown with connected branching and substantial hanging foliage
Uniform fork and bare twig patterns look mechanically repeated
Flat pale trunk lacks the species bark colour variation, shedding and surface character
Basal protrusions do not demonstrate a complete root collar and root system
limits: Photographs are references, not measured geometry or permission to copy assets. Cultivated trees differ in age and conditions; even the inspected young tree shows a substantially different crown structure. Species identity cannot be validated from pale bark alone. Wind/root mechanics are not demonstrated by photographs.
disposition: Does not convincingly represent the selected species; revision required
